records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Wanted to check whether the onboarding made sense or whether anything got in the way. No action needed if everything's going smoothly.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Hana,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Granite Dynamics* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no customer reply to three outreach emails ([email:dab2b45c], [email:991da193], [email:81844b2d]). Onboarding call was held as scheduled ([calendar:b01883ad]) and plan is active Pro, which suggests some intent, but silence plus no first project with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up from our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on more email, so I'll keep this short.

The usual first step is getting one real piece of work into Wrenfield: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like a guided path.

Would it help if I walked you through setting up that first project on a short call this week? Happy to work around your calendar.

Best,
Priya
